method: Exact reproduction of Unity legacy System.Random and original reservoir/Fisher-Yates; same original 200-seed set, all 200 cyclic stream offsets = all 40000 order/placement pairs. No bot gate reclassification.

fisherYates.assumption: Each j3,j2,j1 is independently uniform. Related PRNG streams do not establish that assumption conditional on selected item.
